thesis: The speakers argue that the moment a technology is fully understood is often the moment one should stop paying attention to it, as the rate of change matters more than absolute adoption levels. They illustrate this by comparing the smartphone dividend, which enabled cheaper components for drones and other edge devices, to the historical shift where consumers now receive new technology first before the military or corporations adopt it a decade later.
